anya: quick update — finished cross-instance KV quant bakeoff (FP8-KV, INT8-KV, hybrid AWQ) on 30B shard topology.

anya: TL;DR inline: FP8-KV -> ~-52% KV memory, median token latency +7ms, p99 +18ms, MRR drop ~0.8% on rerank set. INT8-KV -> ~-33% KV memory, median +3ms, p99 +8ms, MRR drop ~0.2%. Hybrid (FP8 data + INT8 indices) -> ~-44% memory, latency close to INT8, MRR ~0.35%.

mike_r: nice. what infra and batching?

anya: A100-80GB hosts, 4 GPUs per shard. hw-local batch=1 for low-latency baseline, background throughput batch=4. shards pinned. run command we used: 

```
./run_bake.sh --model redwood/30b --kv-quant {fp8,int8,hybrid} --batch 1 --repeat 50 --collect kv_mem,token_lat,p99,mrr
```

sara: can you share perf graphs/artifacts?

anya: uploaded artifacts -> https://artifacts.redwood.example/kv_quant/2401234567/results.tar.gz (contains per-shard csvs, latency histograms, human-spot-check notes)

bench-bot: perf-check: detected p99 > sla for FP8-KV in us-west-2-east-1 (18.4ms > 15ms). flagged.

jordan: rollout suggestion: shadow FP8-KV @ 0.5% traffic first, canary INT8 @ 5%. auto-rollback if MRR delta > 0.5% sustained for 30m.

leo: curious about cold-start/warmup behavior — is the FP8 delta from dequant overhead or kernel switch cost?

anya: good Q. cold-start measured as first request after 60s idle: FP8 adds ~12ms median first-token vs int8 ~4ms (so extra ~8ms attributable to dequant + path selection). after prefix/KV cache populated, FP8 vs INT8 delta drops <2ms. interestingly FP8 reduces eviction pressure (smaller KV footprint) -> fewer re-fetches, so steady-state tail sometimes improves for heavy-context traces.

sara: beyond MRR, any other quality regressions? rouge/perp/hallucination signals?

anya: generation eval (diverse 1k prompts): FP8 +0.4 perplexity, INT8 +0.1. human spot-check (200 prompts): FP8 had 3 low-confidence regressions flagged, INT8 had 1. not huge but visible on edge-case prompts with long-range attention.

mike_r: can you produce a small rollout config + runbook (revert steps + metrics to watch)?

anya: will push PR with canary config + grafana dashboard links. proposed watchlist: model.mrr.rerank, kv.evictions.rate, token.latency.p99, coldstart.first_token_ms, model.fallback.count.

jordan: also recommend automatic fallback to INT8 if p99 > 15ms for 10m window.

leo: ops tip — set kv.prefetch_threshold=16 to mask first-token dequant for common context lengths. helps reduce perceived cold-start for interactive workloads.

anya: noted and will include. planning to start shadowing FP8 next Tue 09:00 UTC (low-traffic region first).

sara: :thumbsup:
